screenplay.fountain:
Title: The Last Reel
Credit: written by Premiere316
Draft date: V3.02

EXT. COASTAL ARCHIVE — NIGHT

Rain on the pier. The archive sits like a ship of cans.

ELIAS VOSS
solitude

INT. STEENBECK ROOM — NIGHT

Elias threads an unlabeled reel. The hood already has a cliff.

ELIAS VOSS
focus cracking into dread

EXT. CLIFF — 1978 — NIGHT

Halden looks back into the camera that should not exist yet.

ELIAS VOSS
recognition

sources.title: Picture intake
sources.quote:
A night-shift conservator at a coastal film archive threads a unlabeled 35mm reel and watches the last night of a director who vanished in 1978 — then realizes the film is still being shot.
